- Primary success criteria: sub-300ms median latency for single-turn queries, ability to pin data residency to us-west, and clear per-token cost targets.
- Stakeholders you mentioned: yourself (product), Carlos (legal), procurement@acme.com (procurement), and finance for pricing.

Ask / next steps: 
1) Can you confirm the economic buyer and procurement contact (email) so we can loop them into contracting?
2) Sandra on security asked for our DPA / SOC 2 evidence — I can send the standard packet, but please confirm who will own the DPA review on your side.
3) For contracting, is Acme comfortable doing an NDA first, then DPA/MSA sequencing? If you have internal turn-time expectations, please share.

I’ve copied Rishi from our Legal/Contracts team to provide routing guidance and expected turn times for each doc.

I’ll follow up with the mutual NDA and our standard MSA template this afternoon.

Thanks,

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>

Thanks — quick recommendations from Legal/Ops POV: 

- NDA: send a mutual NDA (Redwood prefers mutual for enterprise discussions). Typically we can turn a mutual NDA within 48 hours if there are no unusual clauses.
- Security/DPA: send our DPA questionnaire/evidence pack concurrently; call out any data residency/KMS requirements up front. Security review commonly takes 5-10 business days as they noted.
- MSA: sequence MSA after NDA (legal will usually not redline until NDA is signed), but to avoid procurement delays we can: 
  * Send a one-page commercial term sheet (pricing, committed capacity, start date, billing cadence) and request procurement sign-off in parallel. Procurement can issue a PO against the term sheet in many cases, subject to final MSA.
  * For the MSA redline workflow: ask Carlos to return a tracked MSA with key open items prioritized (indemnity, data use, termination, liability caps). We’ll commit to 3-5 business days turnaround for initial counter-redline once we receive their markups.

Owners: Rishi will own MSA response coordination from Legal; I’ll own DPA evidence pack updates and coordinate with Security if they need clarifications.

Let me know if you want me to propose dates for signature or a sample term sheet.

-Dev
Legal Ops | Redwood Inference
